meta.title: Information Request List Generator | GST
meta.description: Download a fillable .xlsx Information Request List (IRL) personalized to a target or client. Generated client-side from the canonical GST IRL article.
meta.ogDescription: One-click downloadable .xlsx Information Request List for technology diligence and value-creation engagements.
jsonld.description: Generate a fillable .xlsx Information Request List personalized to a target or client, from the canonical GST IRL
jsonld.feature.sections: Per-section selection mirroring VDR folder structure
header.subtitle: Download a fillable .xlsx version of the GST IRL, personalized to a target or client.
intro.workbook: Generate a structured .xlsx workbook recipients can fill in cell-by-cell and email back. The workbook mirrors the GST canonical Information Request List — one section per VDR folder, covering every input GST tools need to execute the engagement. Choose which sections to include and add your own engagement-specific requests below.
intro.status: Each request row carries a Status cell (OPEN / PARTIAL / CLOSED) so partners and recipients can track progress at a glance. Pre-filled OPEN on every row; promote to PARTIAL (cream) or CLOSED (green) as answers land.
intro.reference: Reference content: Information Request List in the Library. The section taxonomy mirrors GST's canonical VDR Structure Guide, so a filled IRL maps one-to-one to the folders the responder already maintains.
section.infoAria: Requests included in section {number} {title} — click to pin and edit
section.hint: Click a delta to exclude a request from the workbook.
form.showCanonical: Include canonical reference link in the workbook header
js.noSections: Select at least one section to include.
js.allExcluded: Every remaining request is excluded — restore at least one request.
